core_claim: Country radio's 'don't play two women back-to-back' rule, named publicly in 2015, is still active and measurable on every one of the 29 large-market stations The Pudding sampled in 2022 — and at 18 of them the observed pattern is statistically impossible without an active separation rule on top of women's small airplay share.

edt_01.label: Hook — A song you cannot hear after another song
edt_01.editorial_notes: Numbers 0.51%, 65.01%, 128x, and 1,917x must appear exactly. The Hill quote should be verbatim. End the section on the WUBE 1,917x line — it is the punch.

edt_02.label: The number that should not exist (permutation test)
edt_02.title: The number that should not exist
edt_02.editorial_notes: 18 of 29 stations had p=0 in 1,000 simulations — emphasize this. The (0.11)^2 = 1.2% chance baseline is the cleanest mental model; keep it. Show the per-station observed-vs-chance ratio chart.

edt_03.label: Quarantine, not absence
edt_03.title: Quarantine, not absence
edt_03.editorial_notes: The phrase 'play them where it doesn't show' is load-bearing. The 43% / 21% OVN+EVE breakdown for women's b2bs needs the chart to make it visible.

edt_04.label: A category of one — race and queerness
edt_04.title: A category of one
edt_04.editorial_notes: List the 5 POC women artists with exact play counts. The Mickey Guyton instance (inst_01) goes here as an embedded Spotify track — the audio is the argument. Don't render this section as a chart; it's a roster + an audio embed.

edt_05.label: Three women carry the format's progress narrative
edt_05.title: Three women, thirty-two careers
edt_05.editorial_notes: The 52.2% vs 20.3% concentration contrast must remain exact. Embed Lainey Wilson's 'Things A Man Oughta Know' (inst_02) so the reader hears the bottleneck.

edt_06.label: 30% of station-days produce zero back-to-back
edt_06.title: Thirty percent of days, zero
edt_06.editorial_notes: WSM-FM Jan 28 2022 — 53 women plays / 0 b2bs — is the strongest single-day anchor. Lead with it. The ranked-station chart (ana_02) is the visual centerpiece of this section: it should show ALL 29 stations and the chance baseline as a reference line.

edt_07.label: What the rule actually costs
edt_07.title: What the rule costs
edt_07.editorial_notes: End on the tomatoes/lettuce line. No CTA, no 'what we can do', no summary. The Brandi Carlile quote stays as a question, not a thesis. A final embedded track (Carrie Underwood 'Before He Cheats' as the canonical 'gold' women's track, inst_03) closes the piece audibly.
